_geometry_parameters_comment: Domain sized for M~10 at 0 deg AoA: 3 m upstream of the nose, 12 m of wake, 30 m laterally, Z -12 to +18 m (body Z 0 to 5.6 m). Check the first solution that the bow shock leaves through the outlet, not the side or top/bottom faces. Re-check if rotation_angle_deg changes.
_size_field_parameters_comment: growth_rate: size rises linearly with wall distance past dist_min, each cell about 20 percent larger than its neighbour; it sets dist_max. Measured on this brep: 20.5M cells (13.4M prisms, 7.1M tets), 6.5 GB RAM.
_surface_refinement_boxes_comment: Each box now only SELECTS wall faces whose bounding box overlaps it, and sizes those faces via a Distance+Threshold field decaying to size_far over dist_max_mm -- it does not size the raw 3D volume inside the box (that version produced a 9e9-tet pre-flight estimate on this body, almost all of it empty far-field volume).
_boundary_layer_parameters_comment: target_yplus sets the first cell from freestream_parameters (overrides Size). Ratio is the max growth; the layer count follows from Thickness. Faces up to cavity_max_diag_mm/cavity_surface_tags get cavity_thickness_mm, tapering at thickness_gradient. gap_safety_factor turns on the local wall-to-wall gap cap: each node's thickness is also limited to gap_safety_factor times the distance to the nearest facing wall within gap_search_radius_mm, independent of which face either point is on -- this is what stops two BL stacks colliding across a thin section (e.g. a trailing edge) that a per-face cavity check can't see, since a single large face can still pinch thin locally. Set gap_safety_factor to 0 to disable it and get the old face-only behaviour.
_freestream_parameters_comment: First cell = smallest of the incompressible estimate and a compressible Eckert reference-temperature estimate (wall properties via Sutherland), over wall temperatures freestream T, 300 K and adiabatic T_aw (or wall_temperature_K if given), at yplus_min_running_length_mm from the leading edge (Cf is highest there). Turbulent Cf throughout, which is above laminar, so laminar regions are covered too. For this case: 0.01097 mm (was 0.0201 mm, exact only at x=48 m, y+ about 0.92 near the nose). Optional: temperature_K, mach, gamma, recovery_factor, wall_temperature_K.
_auto_refinement_parameters_comment: Re-meshes until the criteria hold. Failing cells become local size spots (Ball fields at refine_factor x local cell size, grading back at spot_growth_rate, default growth_rate). Inverted cells, folding or overlapping prism stacks and a self-intersecting tet boundary also get local BL thinning (bl_thickness_factor). A spot whose defect count did not drop after tightening is marked stuck. max_yplus is checked per wall node on the mesh as built (the loop may only shrink the first cell). max_prism_aspect_ratio = wall spacing / layer height, met by refining the wall, never by coarsening the first cell; pre-flight prints the resulting prism count and RAM and aborts if over max_element_budget. max_bl_top_jump = wall spacing / top layer height, met by adding layers. max_tet_aspect_ratio = maxEdge / (2 sqrt6 inradius), 1 for a regular tet. Spots are saved to spots_file (default <output>_refinement_spots.json); resume_from_spots_file reuses them. min_prism_gamma: right prism 0.82 at any aspect ratio, 0.14 at 80 deg shear. Non-orthogonality: angle between face normal and the centroid-centroid line. max_volume_ratio 0 disables that check. The 3D check needs roughly 150 bytes per cell on top of gmsh.

auto_refinement_parameters._local_repair_comment: Defects are fixed in place, on and next to the bad cells, in the mesh already in memory; the geometry is never changed. Wall: poor triangles, over-long edges and isolated short edges are re-triangulated locally (wall_rings neighbours). Prisms: a column with poor upper layers is thinned locally. Tets: the bad tets plus cavity_rings neighbours are removed and only that cavity is filled again at refine_factor x local size. global_remesh_fallback true hands whatever is left to the old whole-mesh loop (max_iterations, refine_factor, spot_radius_factor above); false never re-meshes the whole body.
